item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"The President mandates that the Secretary of the Treasury later promulgate regulations imposing specified prohibitions and terminating covered judicial proceedings; the legally consequential restrictions arise through those required regulations.","evidence":"The Secretary of the Treasury shall promulgate regulations"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The segment directs court notification, delegates presidential statutory functions to the Treasury Secretary, and establishes the order's effective timing; these are implementation, delegation, and housekeeping provisions rather than a substantive legal consequence independently imposed by this segment.","evidence":"The Secretary of the Treasury is delegated and authorized to exercise all functions vested in the President"}]}
